title: Agent capability register
description: What agents can and cannot do, task by task, with sources and dates (EE-029), at evidence/capabilities/agent-capabilities.json. Team plans cite these entries: a task an agent cannot do, may not do, or is not known to do needs a named human loop. Kept current by reading new research and by our own evals.

area.description: The layer or MAD tier the task belongs to

status.description: can: no human loop needed; can-with-review: an agent does it and a person or a check reviews it; cannot: beyond agents today; not-allowed: agents may be able, but decision rights or law reserve it to a person; unknown: no evidence yet, so a human loop by default and an eval to find out

eval.description: A result file of our own eval, relative to the repository

decision_class.description: For not-allowed: the decision class that reserves it
